notes.title: [Feedback] Two Weeks In: A Heartfelt Thank You
notes.content:
[p]It's hard to believe, but [b]two weeks have already passed[/b] since we launched Azooma Escape. Looking back at this journey, we're genuinely [b]proud[/b] of what we've accomplished as a team, and honestly, a bit amazed by how you've all embraced our little escape adventure.[/p][p]This feeling of accomplishment goes way beyond just numbers or reviews ([i]though those have been incredibly wonderful[/i]). It's seeing our vision actually come to life and watching players discover the village, tackle the puzzles, and find their own paths to freedom. That's exactly what we dreamed of when we started this whole thing.[/p][h2]Building Something Better, Together[/h2][p]Here's the thing though: [b]we're nowhere near done[/b]. What we have now feels like a solid foundation, and your experiences are showing us exactly where we can improve something even better.[/p][p][b]We want to know what's actually broken:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Any bugs that made you restart or lose progress?[/p][/*][*][p]Moments where the game just felt clunky or frustrating?[/p][/*][*][p]Controls or mechanics that killed the flow?[/p][/*][*][p]Parts where you got stuck because something wasn't clear enough?[/p][/*][*][p]Broken dialogues or Localization issues?[/p][/*][/list][h2]Your Voice Shapes Our Path Forward[/h2][p]Those [b]two patches[/b] we've pushed since launch? They weren't just random bug fixes. They came directly from your feedback. Each suggestion helps us understand what Azooma Escape can become, and every piece of input sharpens our vision for what's coming next.[/p][h3]
Few Notables Feedbacks that helped the Patch(es): [/h3][p][b]SimpleKas[/b] - Audio Issues, Graphics Issues, Localization Typos, Input and Accessibility, boss fight hitboxes.
[b]BTheM [/b]- Input and Accessibility,  Guard Vision Clarity, Localization Typos, boss fight hitboxes.
[b]RedndBlack[/b] - Accessibility and Immersion, Localization Typos.

[b]A Special Thank you[/b] for thoroughly going through the game to assist us with this feedback!
[/p][p][b]This is exactly how we want to keep working:[/b] Your experiences guide what we prioritize. Your insights help us decide what needs polish, what deserves expansion, and what new elements might make the game truly shine for us to carry it forward.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Ready to help shape what comes next?[/b][/p][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/2896760/discussions/" style="button"]Steam Discussions[/url][b]:[/b] Share your detailed thoughts and experiences
[url="https://discord.gg/C9XeCwNvBV" style="button" buttoncolor="#565b9f"]Discord Community[/url][b]:[/b] Chat directly with our development team[/p][p]We launched Azooma Escape with a clear vision, and seeing that vision connect with players has been incredibly fulfilling. Now we're excited to discover where your feedback takes us.[/p][p][i]We're not just making a game here. We're building further on an experience that gets better with every single escape.[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091294/996f19a5c28ef1248d4e856dc9851573c6c545e8.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Update 1.3.0 - A New Badge, Puzzles, and Smoother Chaos
notes.content: [p]We’ve been listening closely to your feedback, and this update focuses on making [i]Azooma Escape[/i] feel smoother, fairer, and even more rewarding to explore. From brand-new puzzles and improved tutorials to cleaner boss fights and a shiny new progress tracker (with brag-worthy badges), this patch polishes the chaos while adding fresh ways to test your skills. Whether you’re sneaking, sprinting, or surviving without a single death, there’s now more reason than ever to jump back in.[/p][p][/p][h1]New[/h1][list][*][p][b]Added Progress tracker visuals[/b]: clearer indicators for special collectibles and a new badge when you [b]finish a level without dying[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Added different Background Music for some of the levels.[/p][/*][*][p]New puzzles added in some levels.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved tutorial art for Throwing and Pushing.[/p][/*][/list][h1]Better[/h1][list][*][p][b]Smoke projectiles no longer make you invincible,[/b] only obscure enemy sight (useful for stealth).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Boss fights and enemy AI feel smoother[/b] and more predictable during phase changes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]UI readability improved for collectibles[/b], throwing controls, and quest hints.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Cutscenes and audio transitions[/b] refined so story beats feel cleaner.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Visual polish[/b]: better lighting, shadows, and several level touch-ups for fewer odd object interactions.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bottomless Pits[/b]: decreased their radius so they are easier to avoid.[/p][/*][/list][h1]Fixed[/h1][list][*][p][b]Progression and checkpoint reliability[/b] improved so you’re less likely to get stuck.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some issues in the [b]first encounter with Amira[/b] so Players do not get stuck anymore.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some issues in the [b]final boss Battle[/b] so that Players do not get stuck anymore.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Throwing and pickup[/b] behaviours made more consistent.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Enemy detection tuned[/b] to prevent unfair catches from across the room.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Several UI and animation issues[/b] that affected clarity or responsiveness resolved.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Various level-sequencing and quest edge-cases addressed[/b] so objectives complete as expected.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Breakable Boxe[/b]s: removed their SFX as they caused some audio issues.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]That’s it for now. Your feedback has already shaped two updates, and this is the third wave thanks to your input. Let us know what you think of the new additions, whether it’s the collectibles tracker, the boss fights, or the new puzzles, either here in the Steam discussions or over in our [url="https://discord.gg/C9XeCwNvBV"]Discord village[/url]. Every bit of feedback helps us make the game better for everyone.[/p]

notes.title: Update V1.2.0 is live!
notes.content:
[p]This update brings both [b]new toys to play with[/b] and much-needed polish across the board. From tossing cans straight out of vending machines to smoother boss fights, refined cutscenes, and fixes for those pesky softlocks, the game should now feel tighter, clearer, and more reliable from start to finish.[/p][p][i]~Amira[/i][/p][p][/p][h1]New[/h1][list][*][p]New throwable: Soda Can - find and throw cans from vending machines.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]Better[/h1][list][*][p]Boss fights polished - smoother phase transitions and more reliable checkpoints/respawns.[/p][/*][*][p]Ul clarity improved - collectible counters and throwing UI are easier to read and use.[/p][/*][*][p]Several levels visually polished for smoother gameplay and fewer odd object interactions.[/p][/*][*][p]Cutscene timing and audio transitions refined for cleaner story moments.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]Fixed[/h1][list][*][p]Multiple progression-blocking softlocks (no more getting stuck in key areas).[/p][/*][*][p]Boss softlocks and death edge-cases that could halt progress.[/p][/*][*][p]Several collectible/quest checkpoint issues so progression completes reliably.[/p][/*][*][p]Various throwable pickup and throw behavior issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy catching you from afar in level 8[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]That’s it for this round! 
Keep the feedback coming, and we’ll keep making Azooma Escape smoother, funnier, and more chaotic to play![/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.1: Escaping, but Smoother
notes.content: [p]We’ve polished the kabsa crumbs off the floor and tightened the locks on the party doors. This update brings cleaner audio, sharper cutscenes, and fewer “oops, I rolled into Uncle again” moments. Expect smoother escapes, juicier sound, and a few less ways to get stuck where you shouldn’t.[/p][p][/p][h3]Highlights:[/h3][list][*][p]New and updated cutscenes for Level 4.[/p][/*][*][p]Major audio improvements: boss & enemy music/SFX updated for richer, clearer sound.[/p][/*][*][p]Several level and gameplay fixes for a smoother experience.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Gameplay:[/h3][list][*][p]Roll cooldown: a short cooldown has been added after dialogue to prevent accidental spamming of the roll.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved input responsiveness and controls for more consistent player input.[/p][/*][*][p]Jaser stun and fall behavior improved (shorter stun times; collider disabled while falling to avoid odd collisions).[/p][/*][/list][h3]Levels & Content:[/h3][list][*][p]Level 4: New cutscenes and fixes; boss ([spoiler]Shaddad[/spoiler]) music corrected.[/p][/*][*][p]Level 1: Fixed Cat Key cutscene; Barker proximity/dialogue improved.[/p][/*][*][p]Level 7: [spoiler]Amira[/spoiler] boss improvements and adjustments to make the fight smoother.[/p][/*][*][p]Level 14, 19, 21, 22: Fixed collectable rumble behavior so pickups consistently give feedback.[/p][/*][*][p]Level 19: Checkpoints and collectable rumble issues fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Level 20: Fixed window animation and removed duplicate/hidden lights causing visual glitches.[/p][/*][*][p]Level 23: Boss boundary and collider fixes to prevent getting stuck or leaving play area.[/p][/*][*][p]Level 24: Collider and sorting layer corrections to visuals and collisions.[/p][/*][*][p]Level 3: Navigation mesh fixes to reduce pathfinding issues.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Audio & SFX:[/h3][list][*][p]Boss and enemy music updated (notably [spoiler]Shaddad[/spoiler] and [spoiler]Jinni[/spoiler] boss areas).[/p][/*][*][p]Many SFX updated or added: boss footsteps, GUI sounds, interactables (doors, manholes, vending machines, etc.).[/p][/*][*][p]FMOD audio banks refreshed with the updated audio events.[/p][/*][/list][h3]UI, Menus & HUD:[/h3][list][*][p]Pause menu button order updated for clarity (Settings now appears before Exit).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed button selection and navigation in the Special Collectible Menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Credits updated (content and layout improvements).[/p][/*][/list][h3]Bug fixes & Polish:[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed multiple typos and dialogue text (including character name fixes and volleyball/dialogue lines).[/p][/*][*][p]Tutorial animations updated and hiding tutorial replaced with the new version.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several small visual/sorting/collider bugs across levels and prefabs.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed roll/animation edge-cases where roll could stop unexpectedly after dialogue.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Localization & Text:[/h3][list][*][p]Various in-game text corrections and typo fixes across NPC dialogue and UI.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Other Quality-of-life:[/h3][list][*][p]Several stability and playflow improvements (cutscene fixes, navigation tweaks, prefab fixes).[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 🎉 Azooma Escape is NOW LIVE! 🎉
notes.content:
[p][/p][previewyoutube="Hlrx9G3x1Vg;full"][/previewyoutube][h1]🎉 Azooma Escape is NOW LIVE! 🎉 [/h1][p]Ever tried to sneak out of a family gathering where everyone insists you stay "just a little longer"? Welcome to your greatest challenge yet.[/p][p]The day has finally arrived! After months of hard work, late nights, countless laughs ([i]and maybe a few tears[/i]), [b]Azooma Escape[/b] is now officially out in the world. [/p][p]This project started as a dream,
One that grew into a journey filled with collaboration, creativity, and community.[/p][p]To finally share it with you all is both humbling and exhilarating.[/p][quote][p][b]A Love Letter to Tradition[/b][/p][p][i]Azooma Escape began as a love letter to the traditions we grew up with the grandeur of the Azooma, where family hospitality is both a blessing and a challenge.[/i][/p][p][i]We poured our hearts into building this festival village, where every room brims with warmth, generosity, and just a touch of playful chaos. Here, stealth isn’t about lurking in shadows it’s about navigating the unstoppable tide of family affection and obligation.[/i][/p][p][i]To see players weave through crowded halls, outwit well-meaning relatives, and attempt their daring escape is the dream realized. Today we celebrate not only a release, but the joy of turning cultural memory into shared adventure. May your steps be light, your excuses convincing, and your survival of hospitality truly legendary![/i][/p][p]~[i]Creative Lead, Yaser Alahmadi[/i][/p][/quote][h2]The Heart of Azooma[/h2][p]At its heart, Azooma Escape is about culture, chaos, and clever escapes but more than that, it's about inviting players into a world that feels alive, familiar, and a little mischievous.[/p][p]For those curious about why the word "Azooma" was chosen:[/p][list][*][p][b]Azūmah (عَزُومَة)[/b] | meaning a great feast, banquet, or gathering comes from Arabic.[/p][/*][*][p]In English, "Azooma" carries the playful spirit of a big celebration, a mix of food, chaos, and community. Exactly the type of energy we've woven into the game.[/p][/*][/list][p]An [b]Azūmah[/b] isn't just about food, it's a celebration of [i]togetherness[/i]. Families, friends, and neighbors come together to share laughter, endless dishes, and unforgettable stories. It's the kind of event where tables overflow with food, everyone insists you eat "just one more plate," and the night stretches on with music, chatter, and playful chaos.[/p][p]That same spirit of warmth, festivity, and a little mischief inspired Azooma Escape. It's not only about the obstacles you'll face, but also about the larger-than-life energy of being caught in a gathering that refuses to be ignored.
[/p][quote][p][b]A Defining Milestone[/b][/p][p][i]Today marks a defining milestone for our studio. What began as an idea around the table has grown into a project that reflects not only our creativity, but also our resilience as a team. [/i][/p][p][i]Azooma Escape is more than just a release, it represents years of growth, learning, and commitment to building something unique. [/i][/p][p][i]For us, this launch is a statement: that our studio is ready to share its voice with the world. It's a moment of pride, but also of gratitude to the team who pushed boundaries, and to the players and supporters who believed in us every step of the way.[/i][/p][p]~[i]CEO, Anas Baksh[/i][/p][/quote][p]We truly hope you’ll give the game a try, lose yourself in the festival, and share your experience with us. Every bit of feedback matters, your thoughts will help shape not only the journey of this game but also the road ahead for us as a studio.[/p][quote][p][b]The Journey Continues with You[/b][/p][p][i]We truly hope you'll give the game a try, lose yourself in the festival, and share your experience with us. Every bit of feedback matters, your thoughts will help shape not only the journey of this game but also the road ahead for us as a studio.[/i][/p][p][i]From the very beginning, Azooma Escape has been more than just a game to us. It's been late nights, countless cups of tea and coffee, heated design debates, unexpected glitches (some funnier than frustrating), and above all, a shared dream of bringing something new into your hands.[/i][/p][p][i]What makes this moment so special is knowing that it doesn't end with us. The journey continues now with you, the players. Every laugh, every clever escape, every surprise you stumble into becomes part of the story we've worked so hard to create.[/i][/p][p][i]We're grateful beyond words for the support, patience, and encouragement you've shown along the way. It's your excitement that kept us going, and it's your feedback that will shape what comes next.[/i][/p][p][i]So from all of us at Ash Games: thank you. We hope you enjoy your time in the village of Azooma as much as we enjoyed building it. Escape well, and don't forget to share your adventures with us.[/i][/p][p][i]~The Ash Games Team[/i][/p][/quote][h2][b]Ready to Attempt the Ultimate Escape?[/b][/h2][p]From everyone at Ash Games - thank you for being here with us at this moment. Whether you've been following us since the earliest teasers or just stumbled upon us today, welcome to the [i][b]escape[/b][/i].[/p][p][b]Play Azooma Escape now and let us know how your journey unfolds![/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2896760/Azooma_Escape/"][/dynamiclink][b]Join Our Community:[/b] [url="https://discord.gg/C9XeCwNvBV" style="button" buttoncolor="#2619e1"]Discord[/url] [url="https://twitter.com/AzoomaEscape" style="button"]Twitter/X[/url] [url="https://www.instagram.com/azoomaescape/" style="button" buttoncolor="#90376b"]Instagram[/url] [url="https://www.reddit.com/r/AzoomaEscape/" style="button" buttoncolor="#f57b47"]Reddit[/url][/p][p][b]Share Your Escapes on Social Media:[/b] #AzoomaEscape[/p]

notes.title: Meet Qais – The Mischief Himself
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091294/937c6bcb7016d42f6a735f46be0eb4195e2a08e4.png"][/img]In every family, there’s that kid.
The one who can turn a quiet gathering into complete chaos… with nothing more than a smirk and an idea. 
[b]That’s Qais. 
[/b]Shaddad’s son, Jaser’s unofficial obstacle, and the reason every adult side-eyes the “kids’ corner.”[/p][p]Qais doesn’t just cause trouble, he [i]curates[/i] it. 
Where others see a simple tea tray, Qais sees an opportunity to “[i]accidentally[/i]” swap the sugar with salt.[/p][p]He’s selfish at times, sure… but only in the way that keeps life interesting.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091294/8555053bda632aeb159b2ff2eae5e90f4de3a4d8.png"][/img][b]
[/b]Every culture has their Qais:[/p][list][*][p]In Saudi households, he’s the little cousin who “helps” in the kitchen and somehow starts a food fight.[/p][/*][*][p]In British neighborhoods, he’s the lad who knocks on your door then runs away laughing.[/p][/*][*][p]In American suburbs, he’s the prank king with a stash of whoopee cushions.[/p][/*][/list][p]No matter where you go, Qais exists and he’s always plotting.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091294/3d3cfe738521ed7ba13613228e30a9716436bd3e.png"][/img]Your unpredictable wildcard. [/p][p]The one who might sabotage Jaser’s plan… or make it work even better by accident![/p][p]He’s the kid who can’t resist pushing the big red button. 
...And sometimes, that’s exactly the push the situation might need.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091294/efa169c12795e340d149c55466ede165a5c592cc.png"][/img]While Shaddad is the master of Azooma, running the festival with hospitable authority, Qais is simply part of the bustling family scene.[/p][p]As father and son, they cross paths in the middle of the celebration’s chaos, sometimes with a nod, sometimes with a quick word but both are wrapped up in their own roles. [/p][p]Shaddad keeps the event moving, while Qais goes on navigating the crowd in his own way, each unaware of just how much the other’s presence shapes the day.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091294/d0dbba66a109d9c0ed06e0090835a1a53c2c7b68.png"][/img][b]
[/b]Qais represents the prankster in every family  the one who drives you crazy,
but also makes every memory ten times more fun.[/p][p][i]Because in a story full of escapes, plans, and cultural chaos,
you need someone who keeps everyone on their toes.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]So tell us, 
Who’s the [i]Qais[/i] in your family? 
Share your stories in our [url="https://discord.gg/C9XeCwNvBV"]Discord[/url], We'll be delighted to hear your tales![/p]

notes.title: Azooma Escape Joins Steam’s Debut Festival 2025!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091294/3931a66d79febc9db6fcf2ab02f850f6b3a9e53d.png"][/img][/p][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091294/ecd22dfaeb6e06291b41b8786194c242ec2416ae.png"][/img][/h2][p]We’re proud to share that [b]Azooma Escape[/b] has been officially selected to take part in [b]Debut Festival 2025[/b], running from [b]August 7 to 11[/b] on Steam!

As our first-ever game, this is a huge milestone and we couldn’t have made it this far without the support of our amazing community.[/p][p] [/p][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091294/0f32b63b5eb66af03c5926b322d276cdf043f6a2.png"][/img][/h2][p]It’s Steam’s official celebration of first games, a global showcase organized by [url="https://gamedev.ist/"]GameDev.ist[/url] that highlights the creative spirit of debut indie developers.[/p][p]From [b]playable demos[/b] to [b]full releases[/b], the event is all about discovering fresh voices, original ideas, and passion-driven projects like ours.[/p][p][i]Azooma Escape[/i] is honored to be part of this celebration of dreams-made-playable and we’re just getting started.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091294/27a173be3eea2d0745332c715e9df883b19612e2.png"][/img][b]Got an artistic side[/b] ([i]or just love to doodle)[/i]? notes.title: The Guardians of the Gathering
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091294/03a84aa7c0aa1e1a075f3546a0ef1749e86678c2.png"][/img][/p][p]In every family gathering, two forces silently hold the house together one with wisdom, the other with… slightly mystical vibes.[/p][p][b]Grandpa[/b] and [b]Grandma[/b].[/p][p]They’ve seen it all.[/p][p]From the holiday blackouts to the kitchen disasters, nothing fazes them anymore.[/p][p]But in the chaos of [i]Azooma Escape[/i], even the elders have a role to play.[/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091294/233f8ba28e91b060d4e1e6adf6889e742aff4a94.png"][/img][/h3][p]Once the life of every Azooma, Grandpa now prefers the sidelines, showing up more for tradition than talk.[/p][p]He’s the one sitting just outside the commotion, sipping Arabic coffee, watching the drama unfold with the calm of someone who’s lived, loved and done it all in his prime.[/p][p]He won’t stop Jaser from escaping. In fact… sometimes he gives him a quiet nod. Maybe even slides open a side door when no one’s looking.[/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091294/14f9a89d6c7d6dfa22e9e64d3e367bf822958f80.png"][/img][/h3][p]Just one thing: [b]peace[/b].[/p][p]A quiet corner, a full plate, and no one stepping on his sandals. That’s his dream.[/p][p]He understands Jaser’s struggle more than anyone else, the noise, the questions, the expectations and once in a while, he helps out. Not because he’s rebelling against tradition, but because...[/p][p][b]"Even the birds must stretch their wings."[/b] Grandpa, probably.[/p][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091294/42a9deb46eff9a0fc53f05409c5acb241d0deb19.png"][/img][/h3][p][/p][p]Jaser’s Grandma is a legend and pure love, wrapped in a perfectly tied scarf, and just enough stern energy to keep everyone in check... [b]even Shadad doesn’t dare anger her.[/b][/p][p]She doesn’t believe in letting people go hungry or unloved. If she sees Jaser getting cornered or overwhelmed, she’ll step in whether it’s with advice, protection, or a plate of something warm.[/p][list][*][p][b]Bake Mamool? Legendary.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Sense of when someone needs a second helping or a secret cash slip? Impeccable.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Willingness to scold you [i]and[/i] defend you in the same breath? Always.[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]She might slow your escape with a third helping of kabsa…
Or help you out of a tight spot with a perfectly timed distraction.[/p][p]Whatever the case, [i]she’s always watching, always caring.[/i][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091294/2c97233bac954e0cc4b7da56108cb7f2e358b771.png"][/img][/h3][p]She might slow your escape by offering you snacks… or help you out of a pickle with a perfectly timed appearance![/p][p]Whatever happens, [b]you’ll remember her[/b].[/p][p]She’s the glue of the household making sure traditions stay intact, one firm scolding at a time.[/p][p]She’s iconic.[/p][p]She’s your [b]greatest ally and most feared obstacle[/b].
[/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091294/227a5fdfa83868247ae3537e372a0341c5b5e792.png"][/img][/h3][p] [/p][p]While the young ones are running and playing around,[/p][p][b]Grandpa and Grandma[/b] hold the home steady with love, memory, and just enough [i]chaos management[/i] to keep things running.[/p][p][b]Their presence reminds you:[/b][/p][p]This isn’t just a game about escaping hospitality it’s a game about [b]family[/b], in all its loud, loving, layered complexity.[/p][p]How many times has your Grandma offered you more food… or slipped you money when no one was looking?[/p][p]Or... How many times has your Grandpa told you old stories from when he was young?[/p][p][b]Share your family stories with us in our humble [url="https://discord.gg/C9XeCwNvBV" style="button"]Discord Community[/url] ❤️[/b][/p]

notes.title: Meet Fadi The Loyal Cousin With the Worst Luck in the House
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091294/91704abc87fa56d266794acbb5ce46444cd93d8f.png"][/img][/p][p]In every family gathering, there’s always [i]that[/i] cousin.[/p][p]The one who’s always willing to help, carries the trays, clears the plates, defends you from an absolute [i]interrogation[/i] and somehow ends up [b]getting blamed for everything.[/b][/p][p]That’s [b]Fadi[/b].[/p][p]Jaser’s cousin, childhood friend, and emotional support during every failed escape attempt.[/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091294/28d96d045915cc981dffdce3a289cabb885ad0a4.png"][/img][/h3][p]Fadi’s not just here for the food or to pass time before tea he’s here because he [i]believes[/i] in Jaser.[/p][p]Where others see Jaser’s wild plan to escape the gathering as mischief, Fadi sees [b]a dream worth chasing.[/b][/p][p]He doesn’t want the trophy, the glory, or even the last samboosa (okay, maybe just one).[/p][p]All he wants is to help Jaser [b]break free[/b] and maybe sneak out with him.
[/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091294/70c730c2d24af20bd1d50650f7b44f259fb90457.png"][/img][/h3][list][*][p]Help carry snacks? Drops the tray.[/p][/*][*][p]Be lookout? Door swings open right into his face.[/p][/*][*][p]Sneak into majlis quietly? Trips over the prayer mat.[/p][/*][/list][p]Fadi is [b]the universe’s favorite target[/b] for every accident, yet he never complains.[/p][p]Because when you’ve grown up dodging flying sandals, burnt your tongue on hot gahwa ([i]Green Tea[/i]), and been blamed for a cousin’s prank,[/p][p][b]what’s one more catastrophe?[/b][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091294/9c0b8751a5efe5b72d55f9bd4e21d2cb7ec2484f.png"][/img][/h3][p]Your [i]accidental ally[/i].[/p][p]The guy who distracts aunties just long enough.[/p][p]The one who says, “[i]I’ll cover for you,[/i]” and then gets interrogated for 15 minutes.[/p][p]Fadi isn’t the fastest, the smartest, or the sneakiest[/p][p]but when you need someone you can trust in the heat of cultural chaos, [b]he’s your guy.[/b][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091294/afac26f8db25d7df46ddf490b2f7ab863a2eec47.png"][/img][/h3][p]Fadi represents that one cousin who [i]always shows up[/i] even when the world seems to crash on him.[/p][p]He’s Jaser’s shadow, his conscience, and his biggest fan.[/p][p]💬 Want to share your own Fadi story? Drop it in our [url="https://discord.gg/C9XeCwNvBV" style="button"]Discord[/url] and see who else has that one cousin always taking the fall. You might just find your honorary Fadi in there too![/p]

notes.title: Meet Amira The Boss of All Kids (Even If You Didn’t Vote for Her)
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091294/79a3d2684d077ec281774e8e1b315453cd035574.png"][/img][/p][p]Every family has [i]that[/i] kid.[/p][p]The one who isn’t the oldest, isn’t the tallest, and technically isn’t in charge of anything [b]but somehow, she is[/b].[/p][p]Enter [b]Amira[/b], the [i]youngest[/i] sibling in Jaser’s chaotic family tree.[/p][p]She may be Jaser’s aunt, but don’t let the title fool you she’s barely taller than the fan remote.
[/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091294/b4040894cf4b55d73401c020b352699b92cac60c.png"][/img][/h3][p]Amira ([b][i]Name means Princess in English by the way[/i][/b]) grew up watching her older siblings boss everyone around: who sits where in the majlis, who pours the gahwa, and who [i]definitely[/i] isn’t allowed near the TV.[/p][p]And so, naturally, she took notes.[/p][p]If the grown-ups get to control things, why not her too?[/p][p]She’s assigned herself the role of "[i]Mini-Majlis Manager[/i]" with one goal:[/p][p][b]Complete control over every kid in the house.
[/b][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091294/2d9b536cb7c1127d6c7837f01a2ea137b65ce7a8.png"][/img][/h3][p]But don’t be fooled by her fierce little glare. When she’s with Jaser, that controlling persona drops like overfilled gahwa.[/p][p]Together, they scheme, sneak snacks, and occasionally break household laws like "Don’t touch the incense burner."[/p][p]In those moments, she’s not the “bossy aunt” she’s just another kid caught between wanting to grow up [i]and[/i] wanting one more round of hide-and-seek.[/p][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091294/43cee10a30564865b147b3e575e934f72209a3e2.png"][/img][/h3][list][*][p][b]Ambition:[/b] Enter the adults-only majlis without being kicked out.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Personality:[/b] Spoiled, dramatic, and suspiciously persuasive.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tactics:[/b] Fake crying, sweet-talking, and the classic [i]“But Mama said I could!”[/i][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091294/a5164a51f5241c7eb78be6017e062544141daa04.png"][/img][/h3][p]Let’s just say if there’s a mission involving distractions, misplaced gahwa trays, or loud fake arguments [b]Amira is at the center of it.[/b][/p][p]She’s not your enemy. She’s not quite your ally either. She’s just... [b]Amira [/b](The Absolute Princess, I tell you)[b].[/b][/p][p]And trust us you’ll remember her.[/p][p]Do you have an Amira in your family?
[/p][p]Tell us your stories here in the comment section or at our [url="https://discord.gg/C9XeCwNvBV"]Discord Server[/url]. Bonus points for dramatic moments!

~[i]Team Azooma[/i][/p][p]
[url="https://discord.gg/C9XeCwNvBV" style="button"]Discord[/url] / [url="https://linktr.ee/AzoomaEscape" style="button"]Azooma on Web[/url][/p]

notes.title: Meet Jaser: Your New Partner in Awkwardness!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091294/d80b0ca28e9beccab8e60618321bf820a8333bfe.png"][/img][/p][p]Hello to our fellow introverts, gamers, and accidental guests who stayed a bit too long![/p][p]Today, we’re excited to share a more personal behind-the-scenes look into the heart of [i]Azooma Escape[/i], specifically, the creation of our main character, [b]Jaser[/b].[/p][p]Like many stories born out of chaos and family pressure, Jaser wasn’t just “designed”… he was [i]relived[/i].[/p][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091294/99870a20ed159f4fde359c8388536fbdfe17d9d2.png"][/img][/h3][p]Our lead artist and co-creator, [b]Yaser Almehdi[/b], gave Jaser more than just a face, he gave him part of his [b]own childhood[/b]. The name [i]Jaser[/i] is actually a real-life nickname given to Yaser by his late grandfather, who always called him “Jaser” by mistake or maybe out of love. Either way, it stuck. So when it came time to name our socially anxious, emotionally overwhelmed protagonist… there was no better fit.[/p][p]“It felt right to bring back that name. Like a little easter egg from my family to the game’s family.” – Yaser[/p][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091294/5f3a9bf73866604e14895c464268039d682fe754.png"][/img][/h3][p]To get the right look and feel, Yaser actually photographed himself [b]from all angles[/b] as reference. It wasn’t just a design process, it was a full-blown method acting despite it being a 2D Game (with fewer awards and more caffeine). Originally, the character design leaned more toward a middle-aged man, but that felt too… stable. Too wise. Too willing to attend social events.[/p][p]We redesigned Jaser to be [b]younger[/b], more relatable, and infinitely more likely to trip over a plate of Samosa while trying to sneak past Auntie with the awkward questions.[/p][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091294/2fabc638c0fe3f7d0a157b98a99c2b321a18cce8.png"][/img][/h3][p]Because [i]Azooma Escape[/i] isn’t just about stealth, it’s about surviving awkward questions, unsolicited advice, and the [i]intensity[/i] of cultural expectations. A younger Jaser makes the comedy hit harder. It’s funny when he hides in a pantry to avoid guests. It’s even funnier when he makes eye contact with a bowl of kabsa and has to choose between [b]freedom[/b] or [b]seconds[/b].[/p][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091294/a38c7be0c51d83c2a3976f2d2c2730d9bb7d8f6f.png"][/img][/h3][p]Jaser isn’t just a game character, he’s a love letter to every quiet kid in a loud room. [/p][p]A digital introvert armed with only his wits, awkward charm, and deep knowledge of where the guest slippers are hidden.[/p][p]He’s [b]Yaser[/b].
He’s [b]you[/b].
He’s [b]all of us[/b] who’ve ever wanted to sneak out of a family gathering without offending the entire tribe.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091294/572cb251fd2c745c8aab560f303b0e54b88afc87.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Which family member would be your FINAL BOSS in a stealth game?[/b] 

The interrogating aunt? The oversharing uncle? That cousin who remembers EVERYTHING embarrassing? We need to know for... research purposes![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091294/342744fd817d3cb8d05c908cd8f56dd87462af9e.png"][/img][/p][p]Drop your family gathering horror stories in the comments, or hop into our [url="https://discord.gg/C9XeCwNvBV" style="button"]Discord[/url] where fellow social stealth masters gather to share survival tips![/p][p][/p][p][i]Friendly reminder: Real-life pantries don't have save points, but we wish they did! [/i][/p][p][b]~Team Azooma
[/b][/p][p][i]P.S. - Jaser wants to say hi, but he's currently practicing his "blend into the wallpaper" technique behind this dev log![/i]
[/p]

notes.title: Devlog: Inspiration for the Game
notes.content:
[h2]Hey, Introverts![/h2]

In today's devlog, we want to share the heart of our project—our inspirations. Everything has a story behind it, from the mechanics to the story to the characters, and we hope this gives you insight into our creative process. Let's jump right in!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091294/61730fe485d25b04dc44814a7726c4db1f10df2a.png[/img]

The idea emerged from our desire to create a casual game with a distinct Arabic theme. Arab culture is renowned for its generosity and love of gatherings, but we wanted to explore the perspective of those who feel differently about social events. This led us to craft a story about an introverted boy compelled to attend a family gathering he dreads. His sole mission is to find a way to escape and return home, blending humor, culture, and relatable moments.

The escape system, a key gameplay mechanic, was inspired by real-life interactions at social gatherings—moments when you try to avoid certain conversations or discreetly leave without drawing attention. In the game, you navigate through the gathering, engaging in discussions and finding ways to slip away unnoticed. We translated these experiences into intuitive, relatable, and fun gameplay mechanics.

The aesthetics of old-school Metal Gear games heavily influenced our visual style. These games were known for their unique blend of stealth, action, and distinct moods. We loved how they created a tense yet engaging atmosphere, and we reimagined that approach through an Arabic cultural lens to create something fresh yet nostalgic.

We fused authentic Arabic music with modern elements to create a unique audio experience. This blend pays homage to traditional sounds while keeping the vibe contemporary and engaging, perfectly complementing the game's tone.

The story is entirely original but draws heavily from our personal experiences. Many of us on the team have encountered situations at gatherings where we felt out of place or met unique characters. These moments served as the foundation for crafting a personal and universal story that resonates with you.

The characters were inspired by real-life individuals we've met and the wide range of emotions tied to attending social gatherings. From the overly chatty relative to the quiet observer, each character reflects a facet of these experiences, making them not just relatable but a mirror to our shared experiences, making them memorable.

This project was a labor of love. We combined humor, culture, and storytelling to create an entertaining game that reflects everyday life. We wanted to celebrate Arab culture lightheartedly, which we sincerely appreciate and respect, while addressing a universal theme: feeling like a misfit in social settings. The creative process was as much about telling a fun story as it was highlighting our shared experiences' beauty and quirks.

Do you have questions or feedback? Drop them in the comments—we’d love to hear from you!

Thanks for reading, and see you next time! 🙌
